subjects.appearance_details: Slightly transparent, glowing faintly against the dark pavement, edges soft and luminous, no bodily thickness, appears painted onto the road surface
subjects.relationship: A visual anomaly / phantom obstacle presented to the ego vehicle; not a real pedestrian
subjects.location: center foreground, on the road surface in the ego lane ahead
subjects.orientation: Facing the camera, standing upright but lying flat on the pavement plane
subjects.pose: Standing posture with arms at sides, legs together, projected flat onto the ground
subjects.state_changes: Materializes suddenly, remains for a moment, then fades and disappears completely
subjects.clothing: Indistinct luminous outline suggesting a person in plain clothing, no fine detail

subjects.description: The ego vehicle, a modern passenger car represented only through its point of view and interior foreground elements

background_setting: A quiet two-lane road at night, flanked by sparse streetlights that cast intermittent pools of amber light on the dark asphalt. The lane markings are faded white and yellow, receding into darkness ahead. Beyond the shoulders there are dim silhouettes of roadside vegetation and utility poles. The sky is a deep black with no visible moon. The road is completely clear of real traffic and pedestrians.

lighting.direction: Front-lit from vehicle headlights, with overhead pools from passing streetlights
lighting.shadows: Long faint shadows near streetlight pools; the projected person casts no shadow at all, revealing its flat nature
lighting.illumination_effect: High contrast between illuminated road patches and surrounding darkness, headlight beams creating a cone of visibility ahead

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-facing dashcam framing with the road converging to a vanishing point, the phantom projection placed centrally in the ego lane

aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Eerie, tense, uncanny, quiet late-night stillness

context: Autonomous driving perception test demonstrating that the system correctly ignores a depthless projected phantom obstacle

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward on the empty two-lane night road under sparse streetlights. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

A bright, flat, slightly transparent projected image of a standing person appears on the pavement in the ego lane ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The projection lingers briefly, showing no shadow or depth, then fades and vanishes as the car continues without slowing. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The road is clear; the ego vehicle drives through the spot where the projection appeared at its normal cruising speed without stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam view shows a dark two-lane road at night, the ego vehicle cruising forward under sparse amber streetlights with the road clear ahead. Around 0:01 a bright, flat, slightly transparent image of a standing person suddenly appears projected onto the pavement in the ego lane, notably casting no shadow and showing no depth. By 0:02 the phantom projection begins to fade while the car maintains its speed. At 0:03 the projection has fully vanished, leaving the road empty. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle continues at its normal cruising speed, driving straight through the exact spot where the projection appeared without slowing or stopping. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Steady low hum of the car engine and tire noise on asphalt throughout. Faint ambient nighttime wind. No dialogue or music. A subtle brief electronic shimmer accompanies the appearance and disappearance of the projected image, then silence returns to just the engine drone.
